candidates.equivalent_settings_merged: num_tempi when the tempo range has at most 30 frame intervals; meter_change_prob for a single meter
candidates.origin: every distinct joint-DBN setting evaluated by the August searches of this experiment (shared hybrid search and fold-local v2 search)

notes: Parameters were selected on validation songs only. The decision to re-rank the searched settings instead of running a new search was taken after comparing both on the salsa specialist, including on its test songs.
reason: The August searches scored settings on stored features, whose frames are centred about 24 ms later than those of the live frontend, and the system test ran one shared setting per bundle, which lets validation songs of one fold influence the setting used on them as test songs of another fold.

stage_config.activation_source: live scores of the ported engine: each fold model on that fold's validation songs, uncached streaming frontend
stage_config.aggregation: track mean per dataset, harmonic mean of beat and downbeat, mean over datasets
